output.summary: FY2026 revenue growth (+46%) matches a commodity price rally (corn +46%, soy +36%) while bushels fell 0.9%. Peers with no new program grew similarly, and this cooperative ranks mid-pack, so the Operational Excellence credit is not supported. The 6% cost-per-bushel gain comes from maintenance cut from $905K to $612K, with deferred work orders up 3.1x to $1.26M, including safety/dust items at Harlan Junction. The near-miss on leg #2 followed repeated deferral, and SP-04 investigation was skipped. The Superintendent is 63 with no successor and no procedures. The expansion proposal rests on FY2026 revenue and unsourced throughput growth, with no staffing or maintenance plan. Defer the vote, fix safety, and start succession.
